g.text: 4-Digit Shift Register Display Controller (74HC595 / TPIC6B595) with High-Side PWM Dimming
analogWrite(16, bright) controls high-side VCC rail
U1 Pin 14 (SER / DS) — Serial data input to first shift register
U1..U4 Pin 12 (RCLK / ST_CP) — Parallel latch pulse updates all 4 digits simultaneously
U1..U4 Pin 11 (SRCLK / SH_CP) — Serial shift clock pulse (MSB first, 32 bits total)
Q1 Base (via 1kΩ) ➔ Q2 P-MOSFET Gate ➔ High-side PWM brightness dimmer (0 - 255)
